name: vault-bootstrap
title_zh: 先问清你五个问题再搭知识库骨架的访谈员
tagline_zh: 新建或大改 Obsidian 库前，先花十分钟聊清用途、内容、检索、隐私与限制，再动手建目录。不套模板。
tagline_en: Before scaffolding a vault, it interviews you on purpose, content, retrieval, privacy & constraints—then builds.
desc_en: Design or create a minimal personal knowledge-base structure after interviewing for purpose, content, retrieval, privacy, and existing constraints. Use for a new vault, a major reorganization, or first-time personalization. Do not copy a complete preset before understanding the user.
why_zh: 它把「建库」从抄模板变成一次结构化访谈，先逼你回答五个关键问题，再生成最小目录。避免建完就废的僵尸库。
why_en: Turns vault setup into a structured interview—five pointed questions first, then a minimal skeleton. Kills the zombie-vault.
limit_zh: 只产出目录骨架和命名建议，不含任何笔记模板、插件配置或示例内容。若你已有明确结构只想微调，它会拒绝并建议跳过访谈。
limit_en: Outputs only folder skeleton & naming advice—no templates, plugin configs, or sample notes. If you already know your structure, it refuses and.
title_en: Interview-first vault scaffolder for personal KB
